_doc: Declarative image list for tools/images.py. src is relative to research/raw/images/ (Commons downloads live in research/raw/commons/, hence '../commons/'). crop = [left, top, right, bottom] in source pixels (optional). Each variant writes site/assets/img/<name>-<width>.webp. Hala's own photos (ASSET_INVENTORY status USE) for activities; Wikimedia Commons files only as CONTEXT-ONLY place photos, each with a 'credit' block that build.py prints next to the photo and on /credits/.
